discourse.title: Sprouts Of Faith
discourse.excerpt: The love of the milk maids (gopis) of Dwaraka ... is, let Me tell you, the genuine love that is beyond physical awareness (sahaja prema), that is unaffected by praise or blame.
discourse.theme: Genuine love (sahaja prema) is beyond physical awareness — unaffected by praise or blame, like a lotus leaf above the water.

reflection: Swami holds up the gopis' love as the model: not a feeling that rises with praise and falls with blame, but a steady, natural love rooted deep like the lotus stalk. Today, notice one place where your kindness depends on appreciation — and offer it steadily anyway, without waiting for praise. (Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 2, 25 Nov 1962)

video.title: The Love That Lord Krishna Came to Teach | Sathya Sai Baba Discourse on Sep 2, 1991

seva_nudge: Love someone steadily today without keeping score — a kind word to a family member whether or not it is returned, and an extra prayer for someone who has criticised you.
